title: At the airport in English: 8 phrases, a real conversation and speaking practice | English Routine
description:
At the airport — في المطار
A full lesson for everyday American English, with Arabic help: 8 words and phrases, a real conversation, 3 listening questions, then your turn to speak.
درس كامل: ٨ كلمات بمعناها بالعربي، الحوار، ٣ أسئلة، وبعدين دورك تتكلم بصوتك.

Chapters
0:00 8 words
0:43 The conversation
1:17 3 questions
1:44 Your turn: speak
2:34 Good to know

Words
• check in = يعمل تشيك إن
• boarding pass = كارت الصعود للطيارة
• carry-on = شنطة إيد
• aisle seat = كرسي جنب الممر
• window seat = كرسي جنب الشباك
• delayed = متأخرة
• gate = البوابة
• overweight = وزنها زيادة

Practice this situation in the app (it plays the other person and shows you what to fix), one of 665 real-life situations, A1 to C2:
